# Hand-written script values (NOT regenerated by scripts/advance_parser.py).
# All are evaluated with a country as root; call them as scope:actor.<name>.

# Tribesmen belonging to the Tribes estate, in pop_size units (thousands).
# Cossack tribesmen are left out: they belong to the Cossacks estate, and the
# bribe is offered from the Tribes estate's action menu.
rl_tribal_tribesmen = {
	value = 0
	every_pop = {
		limit = {
			pop_type = pop_type:tribesmen
			estate_type = estate_type:tribes_estate
		}
		add = pop_size
	}
}

# Whole population, summed the same way so both sides share units.
rl_country_pop = {
	value = 0
	every_pop = {
		add = pop_size
	}
}

# Share (0-1) of the country's people who are Tribes-estate tribesmen.
rl_tribal_tribesmen_share = {
	value = rl_tribal_tribesmen
	divide = {
		value = rl_country_pop
		min = 1
	}
}

# Peasants belonging to the Peasants estate, in pop_size units (thousands).
# Dhimmi and Gaelic-clan peasants belong to other estates and are left out.
rl_estate_peasants = {
	value = 0
	every_pop = {
		limit = {
			pop_type = pop_type:peasants
			estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate
		}
		add = pop_size
	}
}

# Share (0-1) of the country's people who are Peasants-estate peasants.
rl_estate_peasants_share = {
	value = rl_estate_peasants
	divide = {
		value = rl_country_pop
		min = 1
	}
}

# Total curse stacks on the country. Each curse keeps rl_curse_<n>_next, its
# size after the next application (see rl_stack_curse), so its current size
# is that minus 1.
rl_curse_stacks = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = rl_curse_1_next }
		add = var:rl_curse_1_next
		subtract = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = rl_curse_2_next }
		add = var:rl_curse_2_next
		subtract = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = rl_curse_3_next }
		add = var:rl_curse_3_next
		subtract = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = rl_curse_4_next }
		add = var:rl_curse_4_next
		subtract = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = rl_curse_5_next }
		add = var:rl_curse_5_next
		subtract = 1
	}
	min = 0
}

# Token price of Cleanse in the token shop: 2 plus 1 per curse stack, so one
# curse costs 3 and every extra stack adds a token. Capped at 10, the most
# tokens a player can hold, so a cleanse is always reachable -- a heavily
# cursed realm just has to empty its whole bank for it.
rl_cleanse_cost = {
	value = 2
	add = rl_curse_stacks
	max = 10
}
